# The Living Room Vet

Website: https://thelivingroom.vet
Location: 2619 Spruce Street, Boulder, CO, 80302
Service status: Housecalls: targeting late 2027 · Clinic: targeting early 2027. Target dates are estimates; contact the practice for current availability.
Phone: (720) 764-6677
Email: admin@thelivingroom.vet
Planned hours (America/Denver): Monday–Saturday, 9 am–5 pm Mountain Time
Contact: https://thelivingroom.vet/contact#contact-form

Emergency guidance: If you can’t reach us, contact your nearest local 24-hour emergency veterinary service.
Website inquiries request follow-up and are not confirmed appointments. The contact form is not monitored for emergencies.

## Page summaries

### Housecall & Clinic Veterinary Care Coming to Boulder
https://thelivingroom.vet/
Comfort-focused veterinary care for Boulder pets and families. Housecalls: targeting late 2027 · Clinic: targeting early 2027. Contact the practice for availability.

### The Experience
https://thelivingroom.vet/experience
Learn how The Living Room Vet is planning a calmer, relationship-centered veterinary care experience for Boulder pets and families.

### Planned Veterinary Services
https://thelivingroom.vet/services
Explore planned wellness, senior, illness, diagnostics, surgery, laser therapy, and vaccination services for the future housecall and clinic practice.

### Wellness Care
https://thelivingroom.vet/services/wellness
Planned preventive veterinary care for Boulder pets, including exams, vaccines, nutrition guidance, and health screening once appointments open.

### Senior Pet Care
https://thelivingroom.vet/services/senior-care
Planned senior pet care focused on comfort, mobility, quality of life, and ongoing health monitoring for aging pets.

### Illness Care
https://thelivingroom.vet/services/illness-care
Planned illness visits for Boulder pets, with service availability and urgent-care boundaries to be confirmed before scheduling opens.

### Diagnostics
https://thelivingroom.vet/services/diagnostics
Planned veterinary diagnostic services for the future practice, with equipment, availability, and visit suitability to be confirmed before launch.

### Surgery
https://thelivingroom.vet/services/surgery
Planned surgical care information for The Living Room Vet, pending owner-approved service scope, equipment, and scheduling details.

### Laser Therapy
https://thelivingroom.vet/services/laser-therapy
Planned therapeutic laser care information for pets, pending confirmed treatment availability and owner-approved pricing.

### Vaccinations
https://thelivingroom.vet/services/vaccinations
Planned vaccination care information for Boulder pets, with exact service menu, certificates, and availability to be confirmed before launch.

Meet the practice vision for The Living Room Vet, a comfort-focused veterinary practice preparing to serve Boulder pets and families.
